import sqlite3
import pytest


def make_db():
    conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    conn.execute("CREATE TABLE trips (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, destination TEXT, day INTEGER, activity TEXT, cost REAL, status TEXT)")
    conn.executemany("INSERT INTO trips VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)", [
        (1, "Paris", 2, "Museum", 30.0, "planned"),
        (2, "Rome", 1, "Colosseum", 25.5, "booked"),
        (3, "Paris", 1, "Cafe", 12.0, "done"),
        (4, "Paris", 2, "River walk", 12.0, "planned"),
        (5, "Rome", 3, "Forum", 18.0, "cancelled"),
    ])
    conn.commit()
    return conn


def test_search_filters_and_exact_row_shape():
    conn = make_db()
    rows = search_itineraries(conn, destination="Paris", min_cost=12, max_cost=30, status="planned")
    assert rows == [
        {"id": 1, "destination": "Paris", "day": 2, "activity": "Museum", "cost": 30.0, "status": "planned"},
        {"id": 4, "destination": "Paris", "day": 2, "activity": "River walk", "cost": 12.0, "status": "planned"},

    conn = make_db()
    rows = search_itineraries(conn, destination="Paris", sort_by="day", descending=False)
    assert [r["id"] for r in rows] == [3, 1, 4]
    rows = search_itineraries(conn, destination="Paris", sort_by="cost", descending=True)
    assert [r["id"] for r in rows] == [1, 3, 4]
